items.title: 67260_Freddie Moore oral history interview
items.q: Later, when we all started at the Onyx Club... no, Jimmmy Ryan's.

ctx.x: All right. Now we're in, let's say, the late Forties. You've been with Bechet, you've been with Art Hodes. Did you play a little bit with Wilbur DeParis before 1950, or was this later?
Later, when we all started at the Onyx Club... no, Jimmmy Ryan's.
Jimmy Ryan's, okay. And how about Bob Wilbur? You played with Bob Wilbur in 1948?
